item.title: SHAFT 0.83.0
item.description:
Clear conversation (#72): in the Mac, iPhone and iPad apps and the web, ⋯ → Clear

conversation… makes Main or a thread start fresh where it is. The instance's

conversation so far is ended and written up, the next reply no longer reads it,

and the feed starts at a "Cleared" line, with the earlier messages under "Show

the N earlier messages". Nothing is deleted. It replaces the web's old "Clear this

thread", which only did what Close thread does.

Minor: a new user-visible capability. Gate (shaft gate budget) within budget on

ea2c2661 with template f02e2174.
